faq.q: What is the maximum passenger limit for a boat rental in Marbella in 2042?
faq.a: The maximum passenger limit for most yachts in our Marbella fleet is 12 people. This applies to vessels like the Mangusta 80 (24m), Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m), Canados 86 (26m), Ferretti 94 (29m), K80 (24m), and Maiora 26m (26m). Smaller boats have lower limits: for example, the Dubhe (8m) and Mariah SX21 (6.4m) take up to 5 passengers.

faq.q: How many people can the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 take?

faq.q: Are children counted in the passenger limit for Marbella boat rentals?
faq.a: Yes, children are counted as passengers. All passenger limits are based on the total number of people on board, including infants, children, and adults. data.body_html:
Planning a group outing on the Costa del Sol in 2042? Knowing the Marbella boat rental group size limits 2042 is essential before you book. Whether you’re a couple of 5 or a crew of 12, our fleet at Boat Rental Marbella has a vessel to match. All charters depart from Puerto Banús and include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT. No surprises.

Maximum passengers by boat class

Our fleet ranges from compact 5-person speedboats to spacious 12-person luxury yachts. Here’s the breakdown:

  • 5 passengers max: Dubhe (8m), Mariah SX21 (6.4m), Speedboat (7m)
  • 6 passengers max: Red Tide (11m)
  • 8 passengers max: Bandido (11.5m)
  • 9 passengers max: Astondoa 40 (12.5m)
  • 10 passengers max: Fairline Targa 12m (12m), Lagoon 380 (11.6m), Pershing 46 (14m)
  • 11 passengers max: Azimut 39 (12.5m)
  • 12 passengers max: Mangusta 80 (24m), Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m), Canados 86 (26m), Ferretti 94 (29m), K80 (24m), Mangusta 80 Grey (24m), Maiora 26m (26m)

All limits are set by manufacturer specs and Spanish maritime regulations. We never invent numbers.

Why passenger limits matter

Capacity isn’t just about comfort—it’s about safety. Each boat is certified for a maximum number of people based on its size, stability, and life raft capacity. Exceeding the limit invalidates insurance and risks fines or accidents. Our skippers enforce these limits strictly. For a group of 12, choose a 12-passenger yacht like the Mangusta 80 or Azimut 58. For smaller groups, the Dubhe or Mariah SX21 are perfect for 5.

Pricing for different group sizes

Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours up to €2,299 for 8 hours, including skipper, drinks, and VAT. Tier B boats (Mangusta 80) start at €4,719 for 4 hours and include a free jet ski. For other boats, pricing is available on request via WhatsApp. All prices include the full package—no hidden extras.

Children and infants: counted as passengers

Yes, children of any age count toward the passenger limit. A family of 4 adults plus 1 infant = 5 passengers. Always tell us the exact number of guests, including babies, when booking. This ensures the correct boat and safety equipment.

Multi-boat bookings for larger groups

If you have more than 12 people, we can charter two or more boats simultaneously. All depart from Puerto Banús, and we can coordinate itineraries so you stay together. Contact us via WhatsApp for custom quotes and availability.

Where all charters depart from

Every boat in our fleet departs from Puerto Banús, Marbella’s iconic marina. You’ll meet the skipper at the dock, board your vessel, and set off along the coast toward Cabopino, Cala del Faro, or Estepona. The Golden Mile and La Concha provide a stunning backdrop.
